column1: # Canonical repo form: docs/repo-policy.md. internal/repopolicy/canon_test.go runs every row through
# image/repo-policy.sh (bash), image/repo-guard.js (node) and internal/repopolicy (Go); all three
#   - in the host column means no host argument; in the expected column, "rejected" (no canonical form).
#   A cell starting with " is a Go string literal ("a\tb", "café"), for characters a TSV can't hold.
# a dotted first segment is the host, so canonical forms are stable
# --- bare paths with a host argument (the git guard's upload-pack path)
# userinfo ends at the first /: an @ after it is in the path, which is invalid
# one slash: git reads it as scp-like with host "ssh", which has no dot
# hosts need a dot (FQDN or IPv4): the git guard runs ssh with -F /dev/null, so aliases never resolve
# --- characters: printable ASCII only, ASCII-only lowercasing
